top_choice_rationale: The GLP-1 award to Drucker, Holst and Mojsov rests on mature, mechanistically complete work: Holst's physiology of GLP-1 and its incretin effect, Mojsov's identification of the biologically active form, and Drucker's discovery of its actions and therapeutic role. It has been validated by large clinical benefit in type 2 diabetes and obesity, and the three-person allocation and citation scope are clean, whereas no award would forgo an unusually ready and consequential achievement.
